title: Bilge Callout vs Low-Voltage Correlation
dataSources: Battery telemetry (`marine:battery`), AIS traffic (`marine:ais`), shore power (`marina:power`), tide forecasts (`tide:table`), export syncs (`marine:export`).
app: Boating and marine telemetry — Victron BMV battery exports, AIS transponder logs, shore-power meter readings, and NOAA tide tables — streamed to Splunk HEC via NMEA exports and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=marine:battery battery_bank=* bilge_followup=*
| stats count as total, sum(eval(if(bilge_followup="yes",1,0))) as matched by battery_bank
| eval a_bilge_follow_up_pct=round(100*matched/total,1)
| sort - a_bilge_follow_up_pct
description: Measures the percentage of battery events that end with a bilge follow-up by battery bank.
value: Completion and exception percentages make it easier to spot which battery bank are helping or hurting battery events.
implementation: Store a normalized flag for `a bilge follow-up` on `marine:battery` events and summarize the hit rate by `battery_bank`.
visualization: Table of battery bank with percentage of battery events ending with a bilge follow-up.
grandmaExplanation: It nudges how often a bilge follow-up happens for each battery bank so you can see where battery events go smoothly or get stuck.
